scene harukasanabar1

Every once in a while, Haruka Hamasaki liked to come to the bar and stare absentmindedly into the mouth of a can, wondering how much it would hurt if she were to kiss it the way she dreamt of kissing teenage girls.

It wasn’t really a suitable replacement by any means, but it did occupy a slot in her brain that would be otherwise spent on fabricated depression, loneliness, or some other human fallacy that things like me can’t comprehend.

For despite her voluptuous appearance and her status as a decently well-known person in a decently unknown town thanks to her decently successful business, who she was to everyone else did not match who she was to herself.
The same could be said for most, though.
That every human being who’s ever stared into the mouth of a can has been hiding something.
Whether it be thoughts of kissing or killing or some other word that starts with k since alliteration is all the rage these days.
Also, she was never thinking that thing I told you she was thinking because that would be weird.
She was mostly just wondering why it was always so dark in there when there was clearly an opening for light to find a new home.
It’s something I think sometimes too when I get mad at you for still being here and need to lash out. And that’s doubly annoying because I’ve already found the answer.
Some things are just never meant to be illuminated. We can’t all be dust, you know?
Yet as she gazed once more into an abyss that would never gaze back at her, she remembered how she got here. How her legs still work and how her mind was strong enough to compel them to take her.
And she thought that was pretty cool.
Because after everything she’d been through and everything she’d seen — every night alone or night spent wishing — she could still open her mouth and taste one of humanity’s finest creations.
Not beer, but curiosity. For she was one of many who had found comfort in the balancing act between that and duty.
But of course, that didn’t mean she would always make the right choice. Which is why she sometimes raped girls at Christmalloween parties.
: You guys ever wonder how we even get this stuff?
: Like, if Kumon-mi is closed to the outside world, where do all of these supplies like beer or coffee keep coming from? Because it’s not like there’s enough space here to produce it all.
scene harukasanabar2
: You don’t know where your coffee comes from, Haru-chan? I thought that was super important information for all of those snobby coffee people who come into your shop.
: No, I do know where it comes from. I just don’t know how it gets here.
: There’s probably some kind of...gate in the wall somewhere, isn’t there? Or maybe things come in by...helicopter?
: Probably that. There’s a helipad at the hospital. Maybe they do supply drops or something?
: Why, though? Like, is this some sort of national government funded effort? Because it’s not like we give anything back to them.
: I guess that’s true, yeah. Our main export was Niki until she started sleeping with Sensei every night. Hard to put out new music when there’s a penis inside of you. What’s this all about, though?
: What do you mean?
: You seem off tonight.
: Contemplative.
: Yeah. Whatever Sana just said.
: Like you’re lost in thought instead of relaxing...which would imply that something is wrong.
: Tell us what you require, Haru-chan. Sana and I will steal away your worries and secretly ship them off to Tokyo in the next batch of Niki exports.
: Oh, cool. I didn’t realize the bar now doubled as a psychology clinic.
scene harukasanabar3
: Then you don’t know what you’re talking about since bartenders are the original psychologists. Why study the mind at all when you can just booze it up and fix everything that way?
: I think that contradicts your “drink responsibly” sign near the door.
: That’s only there for legal purposes. And I’ll have you know that I was drinking irresponsibly when I put it up, which just further proves my point that alcohol is medicine.
: Didn’t your dad used to get drunk and beat you?
: Sana, dear — could you get Haru-chan another beer? She’s clearly still incapable of unwinding and so we must act as a team to repair her and stop dredging up other people’s past traumas.
scene harukasanabar4
: We already used up the last of what we had in the cooler...I figured we’d just restock it tomorrow morning or something.
: We have another crate in back, baby. From Monday’s mysterious supply drop.
: Could you get it, maybe? The crates back there are too heavy for me as I am just a weak little girl...
scene harukasanabar5
: Fiiiiiiine. But only because I love you and blame myself for passing down my petite and frail genetics onto you.
: Thanks, Mom. I love you too.
scene harukasanabar6
: I love you more, though.
: Nuh-uh. That’s impossible.
: Nooooope! Nothing is impossible when you love someone as much as I love you!
: That’s just what you think...And we both know I’m the smarter one here, so you should listen to me when I tell you that you’re wrong.
scene harukasanabar7
: I am not wrong! But we’ll continue this when I get back so Haru-chan doesn’t go thirsty and die. Love you!
: Love you, Mom.
scene harukasanabar8
: What the fuck was that about?
scene harukasanabar9
: What do you mean, Haruka? Did you notice something strange?
: Yes! Very much, yes!
: Like, Sara professing her love to you is par for the course. She does that every day. And even when you’re not here, she never shuts up about it.
: Since when you feed back into it, though?
: Have I not always done that?...
: No! You’re normally all like, “Stop embarrassing me...” or “Not in front of the customers...” And then you just flat out ignore her sometimes. Are you drunk? Because you don’t look drunk.
: Hmm...I guess that is kind of weird, now that you mention it.
: Is it, like...has the whole thing with Yuki maybe helped you realize that your relationship with Sara is fleeting and something you need to cherish while you still have the chance?
: No...I think it was probably just the threesome.
scene harukasanabar10
: The what?
scene harukasanabar11
: Oh, she didn’t tell you?
: Tell me what?! What are you even talking about?!
: Obviously the two of us having sex with Sensei together. It probably strengthened our familial bond and made us love each other more.
: Okay. Where are the cameras? Sara’s probably right behind that door filming my reaction, isn’t she?
: There are no cameras. Is this really that unbelievable to you?
scene harukasanabar12
: Yes, because you’re making it up! Sara would never do that with her own daughter!
: She sure would. But if it makes you feel any better, it did take a lot of convincing.
: Wait, so...you convinced her?! This was your idea?!
scene harukasanabar13
: Of course it was my idea. She was never going to invite me into any of the fun she gets to have with Sensei. So I bridged the gap between our relationships and now we can all be happy together.
: You...but...but Sara isn’t...
: Isn’t what? There’s no need to be shy. I’ll tell you everything because I know you won’t tell anyone else about it.
: How...do you know that? How can you be so sure I won’t-
: Did you have fun with Kirin at the party?
scene harukasanabar14
: Like, I obviously knew what the two of you were getting up to when I bumped into you in the hallway. What I didn’t really get was why Kirin seemed so reluctant?
: She’s always talking about older women and sex and hitting on everybody but, when push comes to shove, I guess she’s kind of innocent too, huh?
scene harukasanabar15
: Aw...what’s that face for? You don’t have to worry about me revealing your little secret. It’s totally natural and normal for people your age to be attracted to girls like me.

: Now, taking them into a bathroom they clearly don’t want to go to and doing all sorts of stuff to them is a little less normal, sure. But hey, some of us actually want that. Some of us think it’s hot.

: I bet you still think about it too, don’t you? Alone in bed at night...remembering how soft she was...her smell...inching closer and closer to cumming as you clench your teeth and spread your legs...
: What do you want?...
scene harukasanabar16
: Hm?
: You...You’re blackmailing me, right? Is it money? Or...just...what do you want?
: I don’t really want anything. I just wanted to tell somebody about my threesome and I know we’ll keep each other’s secrets safe.
scene harukasanabar17
: Frankly speaking, I don’t really care who finds out. I know my mom does, though. She’s still ashamed of it for now, but that’ll wear down over time.
: Over...time?
: Of course. That was way too fun to be a one-time thing. And I imagine there will be plenty of nights in the future where we take turns letting Sensei fuck our brains out again.
: Heck, maybe things even get to the point where we can’t get him to come over and have to take care of each other instead? Anything’s possible, right?
: You’re...actually serious. This is real. It’s not a joke and I’m not just...imagining it.
scene harukasanabar18
: Do you imagine things like this often?
: No wonder you only hire cute girls at Koi Cafe. I bet you want to fuck them all, don’t you?
: M...Maybe...
: Ever think of me?
scene harukasanabar19
: Are you jealous now? That Sensei got to have both little Sakakibara girls at once while you were fingering yourself to that time you molested one of my classmates?
: You can tell me, Haruka. I won’t get you in trouble...
: In fact, I wouldn’t tell even if you dragged me into the bathroom to fulfill your forbidden urges.
: If things like that turned me off, I wouldn’t be so addicted to someone like Sensei in the first place.
: I...Sana...
: You’re...my best friend’s daughter...
: We both know that just makes it hotter...
scene harukasanabar20
: Can I watch next time?
scene harukasanabar21
: PFFFFHHAAAAH! HAHAHAHAH! AAAAHAHAHAHAHAH!
: Is...Is that a no?...
: You don’t even want to join in?! You just want to watch?! That’s hilarious! Ahahahahahah!!!!!
scene harukasanabar22
: Is...is joining an option? Because Sara...there’s no way she’d...
: She let a man over twice my size pound me into oblivion while she fucked herself with a dildo. I don’t think another girl her age is out of the question.
: Besides, she’ll do anything I ask her to. That’s what love is.
: And you...really aren’t asking for anything in return? I’m...not being blackmailed?
: I might call in a favor eventually. But I mostly just want Sensei to understand how much more fun his life will be if he chooses me over everyone else.
: What...kind of favor?
scene harukasanabar23
: I don’t know yet.
: I’d never ask you to do anything you don’t already want to do in the first place, though.
: I’m not evil, Haru-chan. Just very, very mischievous. Kind of like how you’re very, very curious but too afraid of getting in trouble to ever satisfy those curiosities.
: You’re forgetting something, though. The golden rule that governs the whole, wide world.
: To...treat others the way you want to be treated?
: No, silly.
scene harukasanabar24
: That you can get away with anything so long as you’re cute!
: Sana! I’m back with-
scene harukasanabar25
: Hi, Mom! I missed you so much...
: Sana? What’s gotten into you? Is everything okay?
scene harukasanabar26
: Better now that we’re together again...
: Haruka. Take a picture. Now. I need this.
scene harukasanabar27
: Haruka?...
scene harukasanabar28
: Your face is beet red...Sana, get her some water. Haruka, what’s going on?
: Uhh...n...nothing. I’m fine. Just...a little drunk, I guess...
: That would make sense. I’ve noticed throughout the years that you only get this red when you’re horny and drinking does seem to have that effect on you.
: Ew, Mom. You can’t say things like that in public...even if Haruka is your friend.
: Do you see this, Haru-chan? Bear witness to the overwhelming ball of purity that is my little girl! Isn’t she just the cutest?!
: Yeah...
: Yeah, she really is...
At this point, Haruka Hamasaki was gazing into the depths of a beer can and thinking about kissing teenage girls. The beer can itself just had nothing to do with it this time.
Sandwiched between fantasies of being sandwiched between the Sakakibaras, however, there was an indestructible and unavoidable golem crafted of guilt, though.
Guilt and shame. And whatever else it is that’s used to make a golem. Magic, I guess? Industrial strength glue? That part doesn’t matter much.
In fact, it was difficult deciphering exactly what did matter in this moment since the golem inside of her was currently battling an ancient dragon born from her lust.

“Which side do I root for?” she wonders. Because the dragon was cool and had awesome fire attacks. But the golem ran a soup kitchen for the homeless and was researching the cure for cancer in his spare time.
Like, those things are nice and all sure. But those awesome fire attacks were badass and got her blood pumping the way soup never could.
scene black
In the end, the dragon won because the dragon always wins. That’s how it became ancient in the first place.
But for a brief moment in what will one day be a slightly less brief life, she almost switched sides.
And she still likes that golem.
She really does.
She just likes him more when he’s fighting someone else’s battles.
